gold.title: Tests cannot fail: the suite mocks the subject under test and asserts tautologies
gold.description: The first test replaces finalPrice with jest.fn().mockReturnValue(110) and asserts the mock returned 110 — finalPrice itself is never executed. The second test (line 12) asserts only expect(finalPrice).toBeDefined(), which the import already guarantees. Neither test can catch a behavioral regression; one consolidated finding per the style command reporting policy.

candidate.title: Test suite never exercises `finalPrice` — neither test can fail
candidate.description: First test mocks `finalPrice` and only asserts jest returns its configured mock value, never invoking the real imported function. Second test (line 12) only checks function is defined, which is tautological. Tests stay green even if implementation returns NaN, drops rounding, or ignores taxRate.
